name: Hayasaka Miki
source:
Ayaka's former classmate and the school nurse at the academy the protagonist attends. With her gentle appearance and personality, she's immensely popular with the male students.

Contrary to her outward demeanor, she has a tendency to look down on others.

However, aided by her skill at navigating social situations, which surpasses even Ayaka's, few notice the occasional cold glances she gives.

She once toyed with the protagonist alongside Ayaka, though neither the protagonist nor Miki remember this incident.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=668255&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
